0022600184.text: The 4-3 Dallas Mavericks, who have lost their last game and sit 9th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, visit the 5-2 San Antonio Spurs, who have won five straight and are 6th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Kyrie Irving (knee) and Max Christie (hip) are day-to-day, and San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Spurs won the last meeting 122-106 in Dallas, and the Mavericks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 0-4 to San Antonio in 2025-26.
